title: Wire field_access refs into resolution and impact analysis
description: field_access refs are extracted by all four language parsers and stored to DB, but the resolver skips them (skipped=true, target_symbol_id=None) and no downstream tool consumes them. This means if a struct field's type or semantics change, sutra_impact won't find the read sites — only call sites. Wiring field_access into resolution and impact/trace would close a real blind spot in impact analysis, especially for Rust where field access is common and fields are part of the public contract.

acceptance_criteria.text: Field variant exists in SymbolKind and is extracted from struct/class definitions in Rust, Dart, and C parsers
sutra_outline shows struct fields as children of their parent struct
field_access refs are resolved against Field symbols using same-file heuristic
sutra_impact naturally follows field_access edges in its BFS (no code change needed, just verify)
sutra_trace has follow_fields option that includes field edges in caller/callee chains
sutra_refs returns resolved field_access refs without any code change (verify)

implementation_plan:
Prerequisite: struct fields are not currently extracted as symbols (no Field variant in SymbolKind). The child symbol infrastructure exists (ExtractedSymbol.children, parent_symbol_id in DB, flatten_symbols()) but is unused for fields. Three phases:

Phase 1 — Add Field symbol kind and extract struct fields (independently valuable for outline/grep/explore):
- src/parser/mod.rs: Add Field variant to SymbolKind, wire as_str/from_str → "field"
- src/parser/rust.rs (~line 126-134): After pushing struct symbol, walk field_declaration_list → for each field_declaration, push child ExtractedSymbol with kind=Field, short_name=field_name, qualified_name=StructName::field_name
- src/parser/dart.rs: Same for class body field declarations
- src/parser/c.rs: Same for struct_specifier → field_declaration children
- Python deferred — field detection via __init__ assignment is a different problem
- No DB schema change needed (kinds are strings). Requires re-index.

Phase 2 — Resolve field_access refs:
- src/resolver.rs:47-57: Remove FieldAccess from the skip arm
- src/resolver.rs:27-37: Add FieldAccess arm to kind_compatible() → match against "field" kind
- Resolution heuristic: filter all_symbols for kind=="field" + short_name==ref.name. If multiple matches, prefer one whose qualified_name prefix (StructName) is referenced in the same file. Fall through to existing Steps 1-4 as fallback.

Phase 3 — Trace follow_fields option:
- src/tools/trace.rs: Add follow_fields: Option<bool> to TraceArgs
- dfs_callers (line 143) and dfs_callees (lines 249-250): extend filter to include field_access when follow_fields is set

No changes needed in:
- src/tools/refs.rs — gate is target_symbol_id.is_some(), works once resolution populates it
- src/tools/impact.rs — BFS frontier uses find_refs_to_symbol with no context_kind filter, field edges flow through automatically
execution_record: All three phases landed in two commits. Phase 1 (e9ec6a8): added SymbolKind::Field and extraction in Rust, C, and Dart parsers. Phase 2-3 (c08e685): removed FieldAccess from resolver skip arm, added kind_compatible mapping for field_access→field|method, added follow_fields option to sutra_trace. Impact analysis needed no code change — its BFS already follows all resolved ref kinds. sutra_refs also needed no change — its only gate was target_symbol_id.is_some(). Python field extraction deferred (requires __init__ assignment analysis, different problem). Dart instance fields reclassified from Const/Static to Field, which required updating extract_language_attrs to include Field in the keyword-attrs arm — caught by existing test.
